title: HIPAA Access Control
text: Role-based access control must limit PHI to job-required minimum. Quarterly reviews are mandatory for privileged accounts.

title: RAG Chunking Best Practices
text: Fixed-size chunking is fast but may split sentences. Use 10-15 percent overlap. Semantic chunking respects sentence boundaries for better retrieval quality.

title: Contextual Retrieval
text: Contextual retrieval prepends document context to each chunk before embedding so isolated chunks remain interpretable. This reduces missed context when chunks are short.

title: Vector Database Operations
text: Vector databases store embeddings with metadata filters. Chroma supports persistent local indexes, cosine similarity, and collection per RAG method for A/B testing.

title: Hybrid Search
text: Combine dense vector search with sparse BM25 keyword matching. Reciprocal rank fusion merges ranked lists without calibrating incompatible scores.

title: SOC Alert Triage
text: Correlate SIEM alerts with asset criticality. Escalate ransomware and bulk PHI export patterns within 15 minutes per incident response playbook.
